name: rosetta-remove-duplicate-elements
code:
use default

let values = [1, 2, 3, "a", "b", "c", 2, 3, 4, "b", "v", "d", "a"]

write_line(values |> distinct() |> join(", "))

let words = ["pear", "apple", "pear", "quince", "apple"]

write_line(words |> collect_set() |> sort() |> join(", "))
fullSource:
use default

let values = [1, 2, 3, "a", "b", "c", 2, 3, 4, "b", "v", "d", "a"]

write_line(values |> distinct() |> join(", "))

let words = ["pear", "apple", "pear", "quince", "apple"]

write_line(words |> collect_set() |> sort() |> join(", "))
output:
1, 2, 3, a, b, c, 4, v, d
apple, pear, quince
